3859|2|4|600.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
3859|2|4|600.evidence: USI median +0.253 over 21 corners (12 understeer, 1 mid-corner front reds)

3859|2|4|600.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
3859|2|4|600.evidence: 8/21 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

3859|2|4|600.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
3859|2|4|600.evidence: median peak rear slip 1.55; 1/1 launches spun

3859|2|4|600.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
